entries.ec6e4fb5414267be: This is a single-segment business engaged in the retail sale of apparel, personal accessories and miscellaneous goods. It operates select shops that handle products purchased from brands in Japan, and original brands whose products are all made in Japan, through both physical stores and internet sales. Revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥23,734 million, with ¥21,894 million in Japan, ¥710 million in Hong Kong and ¥1,129 million in China by region. As of the end of January 2026, the number of stores was 104 in total: 92 physical stores (78 in Japan and 14 overseas) and 12 internet sales stores.
